purpose: Teach: ヒール/ハザード/聖職/刺繍/中心地/辿っ/オートバイ/マンゴー

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ママ、本気で、絶対、新しいハイヒール、絶対、お洒落だよね、ぼく、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Mom, Mom—your new heels are so stylish! I'm really, seriously impressed.
lines.style: Rapid-fire excitement with breathless repetition on the opening 'Mom, Mom.' Genuine admiration breaking through in the middle, genuine but easy, no performance. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さん、本気で、絶対、車の、ハザードランプ、点けて、絶対、安全運転、心がけてるわよね、本気で、絶対、誇り、本気で、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. And your dad—the way he always turns on the hazard lights, drives so carefully. I'm really proud of him, you know.
lines.style: Warm, reflective. Soft pause after 'Yes,' like she's thinking fondly. Steady, maternal tone throughout. The pride is quiet and genuine, not performance. Trails off slightly on the final thought.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、近くに、聖職者の方、絶対、いらっしゃるんだよ、ママ、知ってる?本気で
lines.en: Mom, did you know there's actually a priest who lives near Grandpa's place?
lines.style: Curious, observant. Gentle build toward the question. No rush. The 'did you know' lands as genuine wondering, not testing. Small pause before the question mark, inviting her in.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さんの作った、本気で、絶対、刺繍の作品、絶対、お祖母ちゃんに、絶対、プレゼントしたわよ、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I gave Grandma the embroidery piece I made, actually. She was so grateful.
lines.style: Tender, modest. Soft voice. The admission that she made it sits lightly. The word 'grateful' carries genuine warmth but no pride—just the simple fact of it. Slight fadeout at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏休み、本気で、絶対、家族で、東京の中心地、絶対、行きたいよね、ママ、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: For summer vacation, can we go to central Tokyo as a family? I've been really looking forward to it!
lines.style: Bright anticipation. The question opens with gentle eagerness, not demand. Builds slightly toward 'looking forward to it.' Energy is there but soft—genuine excitement from a quiet child, not performed loudness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃の道を、絶対、辿った、絶対、旅、お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、聞いたわよ、翔くん、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Your dad actually retraced the journey he took when he was young—your grandmother told me all about it. Isn't that something, Sho?
lines.style: Wistful, slightly amazed. Speaking to Sho but partly to herself. The revelation lands with quiet wonder. Thoughtful pacing. The tone carries affection for both her husband and her son—connecting them across a story.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、オートバイ、絶対、若い頃、絶対、乗っていたって、ママ、知ってた?本気で、絶対、すごい
lines.en: Did you know Dad rode a motorbike when he was young? I mean, that's pretty incredible, right?
lines.style: Animated but contained. Slight rise in the middle—genuine surprise at the memory. The 'right?' invites Sho in as a co-conspirator in admiring his father. Warm and energized but still fundamentally kind.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夕食、本気で、絶対、マンゴー、絶対、デザートに、絶対、出すわよ、翔くん、本気で、絶対、楽しみね
lines.en: For dinner tonight, I'm making mango for dessert. Something special for you, Sho.
lines.style: Warm and intimate. The opening is gentle, settling. The word 'mango' carries a small lift—an offering, a delight being presented. Closes softly on Sho's name, like a closing embrace. Quiet contentment throughout.
